tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: bcas chog srog shing brtan pa'i tsakra don yod 'khor lo bzhugs so:

1$0000270ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ thugs dam yi dam/ lha thams cad/ la sgo gsum/ gus btud nas: yul/ o rgyan 'khor ba'i skyon bral/ padma 'byung gnas ngas: bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi/ rgyud gsum/ kun gyi/ don: yon tan phun tshogs gzungs sngags/ nus ldan bsdus: lha khang ngam mchod rten/ bde gshegs sku gsung thugs kyi rten: sa dgra ngan pa'i gnon pa/ bkra shis pa dang*/ye shes/ rab gnas bya ba'i phyir: tshe ring bar byed pa dang*/stobs bskyed pa'i phyir/ srog shing brtan pa'i 'khor lo 'god: sems can gang dag sus/ reg mthong bcangs pas byang chub thob par/ nges: ༈ rabs dar 'bring*/ ras tha ma/ shog bu gru gang tshang*/ la: tsakra mu khyud rim pa/ bcu gsum bri: lte dbus bzhi pa chos sku ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ lnga gling la: longs sku/ rigs lnga yab yum yang snying bri: gong ras gtsug lag rten bdag che ge la rakṣa rakṣa zhes pa lta bu'am/ sngags 'chang srung skyob 'god: sprul sku bdud 'dul/ mu khyud rdo rje hūm̐ brgyad bri: de phyi sku tshe brtan pa'i ched du/ rtsibs brgyad tsakra la: tshe dpag med kyi yang snying rgyas bsdus gang rung*/ 'god: gong ras la lha 'dre mi gsum zil gnon ched du rta mgrin gyi zil gnon/ khro chen brgyad sngags bri: mu khyud la rab tu gnas pa'i ched du/ rten 'brel snying po dang: yi dam zhi ba'am khro chen/ ye shes snying po bdag la srungs shig dang bcas pa/ bkod: de phyi yon tan rgyas pa'i ched du/ ratna zur brgyad la: bsod nams 'phel ba'i ched du/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi snying po bri: gong ras la mi pham rgyal bar byed cing bdud dpung thams cad 'joms par byed pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo ste: mu khyud nang mar chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'dus pa'i ched/ dbyangs gsal 'god:

phyi mar rten mthong tshad byang chub kyi sa bon gzhag pa'i ched/ byang chub rgyan 'bum bri: ste 'di sus 'chang ngam klog gam ming tsam nyan na yang mtshams med pa lnga dang mi dge ba bcu'i sdig pa byang*/ rten gyi nang du gzhug na rgyal bar 'gyur ro// gsung dbyangs drug cu'i chos sgrog ched/ de'i phyi pad 'dab bcu drug nang: 'gro kun dbang du sdud cing phrin las bzhi sgrub pa'i ched/ dbang chen las kun 'grub byed dbyangs gsal/ bri: de phyi rten gnas kyi grib sel der su 'dug thams cad la grib 'byong byed/ mu khyud la yangs pa can gyi/ grong khyer du: 'jug pa'i gzungs 'di bzhugs pa'i grong khyer gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag phyir mi ldog pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa yod do/ dang bi ma la: rten gtsug tor dri med dang*/ padmo/ uṣṇi ṣa bri des them pa la 'dzul tshad byang chub thob/ de'i phyi la: ma grub pa 'grub par byed pa grub pa chud mi za ba'i/ rnam 'joms rigs gsum mgon po'i/ snying po 'god: de phyir phan yon stobs ldan pa'i: lung nas bshad pa'i/ gzungs sngags rgyud nas 'byung ba'i/ gsang sngags ci rigs shong tshad/ 'god: de'i phyir sa dgra dang phyi rol dmag tshogs/ ngan pa kun 'joms pa'i: gtsug tor 1gdugs dkar 2gtsug tor rnam rgyal 3gtsug tor 'bar ba 4gtsug tor dri med 5padma gtsug tor te gtsug tor/ sde lnga'i yang snying bri: yang mtha' mu khyud phyi ma dag la/ mtshon cha me ris bskor: bas sna tshogs bar chad thams cad srung ba'o// zur bzhir srog brtan par byed pa/ mi 'gyur rgya gram bri: 'khor lo'i/ rgyab tu ā hrīḥkha ṇi/ 'bru bzhi dug 'joms dang: ngan pa dgu thub snang brgyad/ snying po tadya thā/ oṃ a ka ni ni ka ni a bi la maṇḍa la ma ye swā hā/ 'god: ༈ ga pur gur gum gla rtsi tsandan dkar dmar te/

dri bzang sman dang rtsis bsgyur te: rab gnas spyi mthun/ legs byas mchod rten la/ srog shing ngam: gnas khang la/ ka zhu lha khang gi/ tog gi nang gzhug na: gzhan yang khang pa gang la byas kyang bzang ste/ gtsug lag khang rten rgyal khab sogs: kun kyang bkra shis dpal byin 'bar: 'byung ba bzhi'i/ sa dgra ngan pa/ thams cad thub: gdon thams cad dang*/ 'byung pos gnas der ga la tshugs: te mi tshugs pas gnas dang rten 'dre can du mi 'gyur/ 'khor lo/ de nyid cong gi nang bzhugs na: cong gi/ skad thos pa'i sa khongs su: sa bdag sdang bas gnod par nus/ ma yin: rnga bo che yi nang du/ yang de bzhin no: 'di yod pa'i gnas/ 'chang ba'i sngags 'chang sogs mi su rung*/ rtsar: lha 'dre mi gsum gyi skye 'gro kun gyis ci/ bsgo ba nyan: srog brtan bzhengs mkhan/ de mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur/ tshe ring 'gyur: yon tan bsngags pa mdo rgyud du gzigs pas gsal zhing*/ bsam mi khyab: ste gzungs sngags yod pas chog / shin tu gsang ste ma gsang na thams cad kyis shes pas gtsigs chung byin yal bas na/ yid la brnag: bcangs pa dang ngang gi 'jig rten na 'phags pas/ bcas chog 'khor lo'i rgyal po 'o: rgya rgya rgya: sā mā yā: : gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gis gter nas spyan drangs pa phyag len ma'o// shu bhaṃ/// / 1$0000250༄༅// oṃ swasti/ gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi gter byon srog shing brtan pa'i 'khor lo bri tshul/ bri gzhi khru gang gsungs pa phyar khru gang las mi chung ba la sngags shong na dang*/ de min che na'ang 'gal ba med pas skabs bstun/ gang ltar yang lte ba dang bcas pa'i mu khyud bcu gsum par/ dbus su lnga gling zhes lte ba zlum por bskor ba'i dbus su zlum po la/ mtshams bzhir thig gis bcad pa'i dbus su/ hūm̐badzradhrik /mūṃdhātwīshwarī/
